description: This file declares parsing functions related to Git configurations and environment variables, primarily converting string inputs into various data types used within the project.

methods.name: git_parse_signed
methods.description: Parses a string value into an intmax_t, with a specified maximum.

methods.name: git_parse_unsigned
methods.description: Parses a string value into a uintmax_t, with a specified maximum.

methods.name: git_parse_ssize_t
methods.description: Parses a string into an ssize_t value.

methods.name: git_parse_ulong
methods.description: Parses a string into an unsigned long.

methods.name: git_parse_int
methods.description: Parses a string into an int.

methods.name: git_parse_int64
methods.description: Parses a string into an int64_t.

methods.name: git_parse_double
methods.description: Parses a string into a double.

methods.name: git_parse_maybe_bool
methods.description: Parses a string into a boolean value, returning -1 on error.

methods.name: git_parse_maybe_bool_text
methods.description: Parses a text string into a boolean value.

methods.name: git_env_ulong
methods.description: Retrieves an unsigned long environment variable.
